name: Water softener

comps.spec: Softener salt (sodium chloride), 10–150 kg — not food grade: check the bag for additives before using it on food
comps.loc: Inside the brine tank; spare bags on the floor beside it

comps.spec: Fibreglass resin tank, about 20–25 cm wide and 1.2–1.5 m tall — reuse as a sand or carbon filter vessel
Brine tank, about 100–250 litres of tough plastic with a lid
Turbine flow meter with a magnet and Hall sensor or reed switch (metered models)
Timer drive motor (synchronous or small DC gear motor)
Control valve head and bypass valve

comps.loc: Between the tanks and to the drain

notes: Use softener salt for hides, de-icing and trade; for curing or eating, prefer bags labelled food grade. Hardware and supermarket stock of salt bags is rarely touched.
